summary.en: Conan, Ran, Kogoro, are at the amusement park. Later, while Yaiba is jumping on a bungee jump, the ring around his feet and he falls into the river nearby. Location: Nichiuri Land Cause of death: Drowning Suspects: Akiyoshi Ishijima, Shinpei Okubo, Kanako Harukawa, Wataru Otake, and Seizou Fujita At an amusement park, an accident occurs during a Kamen Yaiba playing. As Yaiba jumped from a bungee cord, the cord burns and he falls into the water. Twenty minutes later, he is found dead. They identified the victim which he is Yuta Hosono. He is the performer of Kamen Yaiba. There's Akiyoshi Ishijima who operates the bungee jumping. Shinpei Okubo, who performs the Black Planet Man. Kanako Harukawa, who performs the princess. Wataru Otake, who operates props and special effects. Finally, Seizou Fujita, the show scheduler at Nichiuri Land.
